name: modelbrain-mcp
description: Local memory for AI assistants: remember, recall, forget and expand, stored on your own computer. Requires the ModelBrain desktop app.
long_description: ModelBrain is a memory layer that plugs into the AI assistants you already use and keeps what it remembers on your own computer. This bundle is a thin launcher: it finds the ModelBrain desktop app already installed on your machine and connects your assistant to it. It does not install or include ModelBrain. Get the app at https://modelbrain.net/get-it.html.

tools.name: remember
tools.description: Save a fact, decision or preference to local memory.

tools.name: recall
tools.description: Search local memory and return the most relevant items.

tools.name: forget
tools.description: Remove a memory so it stops surfacing.

tools.name: expand
tools.description: Return the full text of a recalled memory.
